description: Change listing prices only after the user explicitly confirms the exact changes returned by prepare_card_price_updates. Pass only those signed tokens and confirmed=true. Requires store:prices:write. Rechecks ownership, approval expiry, current listing state, market guidance, holds and price limits; stale proposals are refused. Does not change automation, inventory, orders or publishing settings. If the call times out, inspect current prices before retrying.

confirmed.description: Set true only after the user explicitly confirms the displayed listing prices.

tokens.description: Signed approval tokens for the exact price changes the user confirmed.

name: apply_card_price_updates
title: Apply confirmed card price updates
